title: But, Or, Why
label: ch:it-unire
canDo: I can set one statement against another, offer a choice, ask why and answer because, say when, and say what something is for.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson gives the infinitive its first job in a sentence. Since Chapter 5 it has been this book's dictionary form and nothing else; per plus the plain infinitive puts it to work and introduces no new word.
